Sasha deliberately paused over the weekend before answering. On Jul 28 he sent a long (~2,000-word) Russian voice-style written reflection. Substance: (1) named the triangulation — P-0318 independently arrived at both Sasha and Uluva, Sasha's own teacher of ~6 years and also P-E734's teacher, whose client bases have essentially never overlapped before (one exception) — asked P-0318 to choose consciously rather than drift into it; (2) positioned Uluva generously as the deepest person Sasha personally knows, top 0.1% by depth, explicitly refused guru framing — named the dependency dynamic that forms around spiritual teachers, said both he and Uluva see through it and therefore do not permit it, centered sovereignty and subjecthood, elevating a potential competitor rather than positioning against him; (3) the core thesis: business and transformation are not two things, there is no separate spirituality hovering apart from the material — the tree metaphor (grows down and up at once, the crown cannot exceed what the roots can hold; unbalanced ascent chasing "high vibrations" while devaluing the material produces degradation in the money area of life; money is the ultimate grounding) — therefore the hero's journey through business IS the spiritual path; (4) dissolved the choice rather than answering it, then gave a direct recommendation: go the business route, transformation happens in parallel by itself; (5) the Formula 1 metaphor — P-0318 as the driver, the tip of the spear, but nothing without a world-class crew (Sasha and Uluva), F1 as the top tier tied back to P-0318's own phrase "высшая лига"; (6) named the risk honestly — "mismatch," expansion without integration, uneven growth — said there is no real danger while supported, both would watch for sharp edges and flag jerky movements; (7) addressed the fear of fast growth (the capacitor / Ohm's law image) — the two fears named (going crazy, becoming someone else), answered: you never become someone else, only more yourself, more agency, more autonomy, more contact with what pulls you; (8) formed the edge verbatim: "я бесплатно не работаю, и никому не рекомендую," paired with acknowledging he has already given P-0318 a great deal for free; (9) closed with three paths (Sasha alone / Uluva alone / both), conditioned on P-0318's budget for investing in himself, named the concrete next step — a 2-hour workshop to surface his unique value and turn it into the core of his business (acorn-to-oak image) — ending "выбирай, решай и дай мне знать." No price or date was named in the message. Incidental: Sasha mentioned running a session that same morning ("Я только что провел с утра одну") — possible revenue not yet reflected in the ledger, unconfirmed.
